title: Silver price rebounds ahead of expected Fed rate hike, Warsh press conference
summary: Silver (XAG/USD) rebounds on Wednesday and trades around $64.00 per troy ounce at the time of writing, up 1.32% on the day.

title: US Dollar: Fed pricing creates asymmetric risks – BBH
summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad says the US Dollar (USD) remains supported by energy-driven risk aversion ahead of the FOMC decision.

title: Bank of England: Hawkish hold risks and November hike – MUFG
summary: MUFG’s Henry Cook expects the Bank of England to deliver a hawkish hold, with UK inflation driven higher by energy and headline CPI projected to exceed 4% after the January price cap reset.
